entry.title: UBC CMS – Website Disruptions – Oct 28, 2026 1:45 p.m. Pacific
entry.content:
Oct 29, 09:50 PDT
Resolved - The disruptions in UBC CMS have now been resolved. Users should now be able to access UBC websites hosted on CMS without being prompted for browser verification.

We will continue to monitor the situation. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to the LT Hub by emailing LT.Hub@ubc.ca.

Oct 28, 14:19 PDT
Investigating - We are seeing intermittent disruptions in UBC CMS. To increase stability and security, users from both UBC and non-UBC networks may be prompted for browser verification. This will involve an intermediate screen being displayed and the need to click "Continue" to reach the site. This prompt will occur once every eight hours, for every UBC CMS website, and is not a cause for alarm.

We are investigating the disruptions and will provide an update when we have more information or when the issue is resolved.
